firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'House Cleaning in Greenville, SC' 2 lines, trade+city; lead carries the outcome; filled Call primary + outline 'Price my visit' secondary; phone in header and hero; licence proof line with SAMPLE LICENCE; clipboard card with ticks and timestamps (signature) in frame; sage band peeks ~64px. 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, phone button in header. Held from 10 by: header mark is a bare 'TH' monogram with no business name (1440-first.jpg, 390-first.jpg), and the drawn sheet behind the clipboard is mostly empty ruled paper.

distinctiveness.notes: Signature shows in hero clipboard (1440-first.jpg), timeline rail + visit clock (1440-scroll-25.jpg), estimator segment bar + tick (1440-full.jpg estimator), review tick tabs (1440-scroll-75.jpg), service checkboxes and footer 'Visit complete 3:10' tick (1440-full.jpg). Palette/type differ from siblings B and C. -0.5: sibling cleaning/B 1440-first.jpg also sells a room checklist with tick rows, so the idea (not the look) overlaps. Service-card checkboxes (1440-full.jpg #services) are empty decorative squares that never tick, so the motif decorates there rather than working.

type.notes: Outfit/Karla/DM Mono, tight display tracking, curly quotes in reviews (1440-scroll-75.jpg), body >=16px. -0.5: 3+ tiny tracked mono caps in one view on 1440-first.jpg (kicker 'VISIT CHECKLIST', 'TUE · 2 PEOPLE', 'SAMPLE LICENCE' pill, mono 'Open now · until 5 pm'). ZIP list set as one unspaced comma string breaks mid-number ('29 / 651') on 390-full.jpg #area and leads a line with a comma on 1440-full.jpg.

layout.notes: 10 sections, tones alternate (1440-full.jpg), full-bleed drawn break, asymmetric timeline rail, chooser now stacked so it no longer mirrors the estimator (1440-scroll-50.jpg, R2 item fixed). -0.5: reviews grid leaves the 4th card alone with an empty right half (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Also #services left column is empty for ~900px under a 4-line intro and #area ZIP card floats with dead space below it (1440-full.jpg).

photo.notes: Placeholders judged on treatment. Rail mixes media: Kitchen and Bedrooms are pencil drawings, Bathrooms and Floors are stock photos (1440-rm-full.jpg #process-story), so the four rooms do not read as one document. Break panel (1440-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg) is a sparse line drawing of a fence rail with dots; it reads as a diagram, not a porch. Area house photo is cool/overcast next to the warm stair carpet (1440-full.jpg). Clipboard frames with slight tilt are consistent. Lazy Bathrooms/Floors frames render blank in 1440-full.jpg and 390-full.jpg but load in 1440-scroll-25.jpg and 1440-rm-full.jpg, so not broken.

copy.notes: Concrete trade nouns (grout line, shower glass squeegeed, pollen film on sills, drywall dust) and homeowner-voice Sample reviews (1440-scroll-75.jpg). MustFix: #contact lead 'Nothing leaves this page until you reskin it.' (1440-full.jpg, 390-full.jpg) speaks to the contractor/builder, not the homeowner. -0.5: #area h2 runs 4 lines at 1440 (1440-full.jpg). 'Price my visit' repeated under all 10 service cards (1440-full.jpg #services) reads as filler.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, call button in header. 390-full.jpg: rail kept with stacked thumbs, estimator and chooser usable full width, no sideways scroll (render.json 320/390 clean). -0.5: break note card overlaps the drawing's caption line at 390 (390-full.jpg, break section, caption text cut under the card). ZIP string breaks mid-number in #area.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word; ZIP has a visible label (1440-full.jpg #area); axe/console clean in render.json. -0.5: in reduced motion the visit clock rests at '0:00 Kitchen' (1440-rm-full.jpg) instead of the complete state, so the static form of the story shows the start, not the outcome. Ten identical 'Price my visit' links in #services (1440-full.jpg) give a screen-reader link list ten same-named entries.

motion.notes: Motion explains order: visit clock advances to '3:10 Signed off' and the rail fills gold as rooms pass (1440-scroll-25.jpg vs 1440-rm-full.jpg '0:00'), ticks draw on checklist rows, estimator segment bar Kitchen/Baths/Rooms/Floors fills and ends in a tick (1440-full.jpg #estimator). Reduced motion respected. Held from 9.5: the services and reviews blocks show no role-specific entrance in 1440-scroll-50/75.jpg, and the chooser output idles as plain text.

wow.notes: Two connected moments: the timed visit rail with advancing clock (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and the estimator whose output is the same visit clock split into room segments with a tick and 'about 3:10' (1440-full.jpg #estimator). Held from 10: chooser output is a bare mono line 'Tick what you see in your house.' with an empty progress bar (1440-scroll-50.jpg), so the third tool does not pay off in the signature language.

polish.notes: Footer is a designed close ('Visit complete · 3:10' tick, 1440-full.jpg); credits now name photographers and licences (R2 item fixed). -0.5: shadows on non-floating things (review cards 1440-scroll-75.jpg, chooser sheet heavy drop shadow 1440-scroll-50.jpg, every rail frame). Header mark 'TH' is unfinished as a logo (1440-first.jpg).

mustFix.problem: 'Four quick steps. Nothing leaves this page until you reskin it.' addresses the builder/contractor, not the homeowner, and breaks the demo on a sales call
mustFix.fix: Replace with homeowner microcopy: 'Four quick steps. This is a sample form, so nothing is sent; call {{biz.phone}} to book.'

elevate.move: Make the rail one document: every room frame becomes a ruled checklist sheet where the stock photo sits taped onto the sheet as a small print with a pencil caption and the tick drawn across its corner, all four rooms (and the area house) in one sage/ink duotone grade, and the pollen break redrawn as a full porch scene so drawing and photo read as the same clipboard.

Rewrite #area as a route sheet: a two-line h2 ('On the route across Greenville County'), the eight towns as ticked checklist rows each with its ZIPs set in mono beside it, and one line of doubt-microcopy at the ZIP check ('Not on the list? Call and ask before you book').
